items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And I used to hang out in a place, we used to call it, 'The House of Meditation'. With Bechet and Tommy Ladnier. They lived there. We used to all hang out at this spot

ctx.x: Yes, now this is another thing he says, during the early thirties worked for several other leaders including Bubber Miley and Otto Toby Hardwick together with Tommy Ladnier accompanied the Berry Brothers dancing act.
Ladnier did, we did that at the Paramount Theater. And we played two weeks here at the Paramount, then we went to Brooklyn and played two weeks. Then we went to Providence, Rhode Island.
